ci_support_linux_64_use_noarchfalse.yaml:
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '15'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.11.* *_cpython
- 3.12.* *_cpython
- 3.13.* *_cp313
- 3.14.* *_cp314
python_min:
- '3.11'
target_platform:
- linux-64
use_noarch:
- false
name: aiohttp
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "3.14.4"
  # Doesn't reliably run fast enough in CI
  skip_import_time: " or test_import_time"
  # Fails since 270ae9cf6a9e6159b5e29a950deb6ff7600aebc5
  skip_strict_parser: >-
    or test_http_response_parser_strict_obs_line_folding
    or test_http_response_parser_bad_chunked_strict_c[pyloop]
    or test_http_response_parser_bad_chunked_strict_py[pyloop]
    or test_http_response_parser_strict_headers[c-parser-pyloop]
    or test_tcp_connector_raise_connector_ssl_error[pyloop]
  # flaky tests
  skip_flaky: " or test_heartbeat_no_pong[pyloop]"
  # test failing with python >=3.11 (python_min)
  skip_py311: " or test_https_proxy_unsupported_tls_in_tls[pyloop-https]"
  # async generator cleanup warning becomes RuntimeError via aiohttp pytest
  # plugin on py3.13+
  skip_py313: ${{ " or test_read_decode_compressed_exceeds_max_size" if not use_noarch and match(python, ">=3.13") else "" }}
  # fails to open socket at desired IP/port
  skip_linux: >-
    ${{ " or (test_web_server and test_handler_cancellation)"
    ~ " or (test_web_server and test_no_handler_cancellation)"
    ~ " or test_run_app_preexisting_inet6_socket[pyloop]" if linux else "" }}
  # emulation is too slow for expected speed
  skip_emulated: >-
    ${{ " or (test_imports and test_import_time)"
    ~ " or test_regex_performance"
    ~ " or test_cookie_pattern_performance" if aarch64 or ppc64le else "" }}
  # failing starting with 3.13.1, likely due to change of behavior in newer
  # yarl version
  skip_idna: " or test_invalid_idna[pyloop]"
  tests_to_skip: >-
    ${{ "_not_a_real_test" ~ skip_import_time ~ " " ~ skip_strict_parser
    ~ skip_flaky ~ skip_py311 ~ skip_py313 ~ skip_linux ~ skip_emulated
    ~ skip_idna }}

package:
  name: aiohttp
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/93/2f/6a91adaa2dc26877d6ed2f54c0370c8910f019db7d77c5c6a194611e93ea/aiohttp-${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 831fc5bd39ec2517851e348f613ddb5447a47cf4b71cb09845af7ad7ed45d8f9
  # download sources to have tests, which don't get installed;
  # installing from source is very painful, beware...
  - url: https://github.com/aio-libs/aiohttp/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 9ec5d815ab97b01597d0b8cfbdad5bdf16ced45b3ee3e0f335e70f2ed0f208c9
    target_directory: sources

build:
  number: 0
  # Compiled per-platform builds plus one noarch fallback (built on
  # linux_64, de-prioritized via down_prioritize_variant) per
  # https://conda-forge.org/blog/2024/10/15/python-noarch-variants/
  noarch: ${{ "python" if use_noarch }}
  variant:
    down_prioritize_variant: ${{ 1 if use_noarch else 0 }}
  script:
    - if: use_noarch
      then: export AIOHTTP_NO_EXTENSIONS=1
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform and not use_noarch
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - cython
    - if: not use_noarch
      then:
        - ${{ compiler("c") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
  host:
    - if: use_noarch
      then: python ${{ python_min }}.*
      else: python
    - pip
    - cython
    - pkgconfig
    - setuptools >=67.0
  run:
    - if: use_noarch
      then: python >=${{ python_min }}
      else: python
    - aiohappyeyeballs >=2.5.0
    - aiosignal >=1.4.0
    - if: use_noarch
      then: async-timeout >=4.0,<6.0
    - attrs >=17.3.0
    - frozenlist >=1.1.1
    - multidict >=4.5,<7.0
    - propcache >=0.2.0
    - yarl >=1.25.1,<2.0
    - typing_extensions >=4.4

tests:
  - if: use_noarch
    then:
      - python:
          imports:
            - aiohttp
          pip_check: true
          python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*
    else:
      - python:
          imports:
            - aiohttp
          pip_check: true
  - files:
      source:
        - sources/tests/
        # used by a test
        - sources/README.rst
    requirements:
      run:
        - if: use_noarch
          then: python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - pytest <8
        - pytest-mock
        - pytest-codspeed
        - python-blockbuster
        - brotli
        - brotlicffi
        - freezegun
        - python-isal
        - if: unix
          then:
            - gunicorn
            - uvloop
        - pkgconfig
        - proxy-py
        - re-assert
        - time-machine
        - trustme
        - python-zlib-ng
    script:
      - if: use_noarch
        then: export AIOHTTP_NO_EXTENSIONS=1
      # don't want the docker tests in the autobahn subfolder
      - if: unix
        then: rm -rf sources/tests/autobahn
        else: rmdir /s /q sources\tests\autobahn
      - pytest sources/tests/ -k "not (${{ tests_to_skip }})"

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/aio-libs/aiohttp
  license: MIT AND Apache-2.0
  license_file:
    - LICENSE.txt
    - vendor/llhttp/LICENSE
  summary: Async http client/server framework (asyncio)
  documentation: http://aiohttp.readthedocs.io/
  repository: https://github.com/aio-libs/aiohttp

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - sodre
    - xhochy
    - ocefpaf
    - xylar
